# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (ending on Crinklewitch pitch) · 2026-11-11 22:06
> Receiver: run /shift-start first, then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (the last open thread is the Crinklewitch pitch).

## 0 · Read these first (required)
None. The repo has no project files (one commit `fa755b9 start`, only `.claude/`). All context lives in this handover. `.shift/` was added to `.gitignore` this session.

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟢 No code or jobs. This was a series of chat sessions, 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30, on unrelated personal topics. The last thread (Crinklewitch elevator pitch) was mid-iteration: the user asked "Can you try again?" and got a 4th pitch, with no feedback yet.

## 2 · Picture  (P)
The user uses the assistant as a general helper: creative prompts, BJJ training plans, media recommendations, shopping, hair care, travel, self-improvement, and designing their own card game, **Crinklewitch**. Most recently (2023-05-30) we were naming Bonus Cards and writing an elevator pitch. Many earlier answers contain **factual errors or invented details** (see §6). If the user comes back to a topic, correct those errors rather than repeat them.

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. If the user continues Crinklewitch: write a pitch that **combines pitch 1 and pitch 2** (they liked both), says **2–8 players**, and names Rule Cards, Bonus Cards and 3 Winner Tokens. Done when the user approves it.
2. Optional: tidy the Bonus Card lists. "Magic Amulet" and "Crystal Ball" each appear twice with different effects. Point this out and offer to resolve it; don't silently pick one.
3. If the user comes back to any topic in §6, correct the flagged errors when relevant.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected / wrong path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Saying Crinklewitch is "2-6 players" (pitch 2) | User corrected it: "we want the game to be 2-8 players" | user changes player count |
| Reusing source.unsplash.com image URLs | User requested it on 2023-05-27, but the service was shut down (2024) [assumed, from general knowledge]; the sunrise reply had no working image anyway | user insists → explain it no longer works |
| Repeating the fabricated Incase Icon Sleeve specs (§6) | Invented; not verifiable | never |

## 5 · Working with the user  (who they are, and taste)
**About the user** [user said; dates are when they said it]:
- Trains **Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu**: has a white→blue belt plan and drills at home (2023-05-20).
- Watching **Hawkeye on Disney+ with their sister**; had finished **episode 5** as of 2023-05-20. Planned to watch **Spider-Man: No Way Home "next weekend"** (said Sat 2023-05-20 → about May 27–28, 2023), after re-watching the **Raimi Spider-Man trilogy**. Added **The Falcon and the Winter Soldier** and **Loki** to their watchlist. Asked about the Marvel One-Shots.
- Has a **Spotify playlist of movie soundtracks** (loves **Hans Zimmer**) and adds tracks **every week**. It helps them focus while working on their projects.
- Laptop battery is weak on **resource-intensive projects**. They are considering an upgrade to an unnamed brand known for battery life, and their laptop is **13-inch**. Their bag is worn, and they are considering the **Incase Icon Sleeve** (2023-05-25).
- Podcasts: listens to **true crime and self-improvement** on a **40-minute commute each way**. Wants to branch out and is most interested in **history**. Interested in *Guns, Germs, and Steel* (2023-05-26).
- Is **self-conscious around new people**. Plans to **attend social events and join a public speaking group** (2023-05-27).
- Uses the **Closet app** (chosen 2023-05-28). Bought **black ankle boots from Zara around 2023-05-07** (said 05-28: "three weeks ago") and had worn them **3 times**. Considering a **Coach handbag**.
- Hair is **wavy, dry in some areas, and frizz-prone**. Uses a **Moroccan oil serum from their hair stylist** ("really helpful"). Considering the **L'Oréal Paris EverPure Repair & Protect Mask once a week**.
- Curious about **drone photography** (2023-05-29).
- Designing **Crinklewitch** with others ("we want…"), see §10.

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Dall-E prompt** (final, about 400 chars): dystopian London sunset, crumbling skyscrapers, broken London Eye, Thames full of debris, empty streets, orange/red sun, in the style of *Akira*.
- **BJJ summary** (final state): (1) white→blue program, Weeks 1–20 (Wk 6 & 7 Mount, 16 Mount, 17 Back control, 18 Takedowns, 19 Passes, 20 Submissions); (2) combined 4-week program "submissions, grips, and the kimura": Wk1 fundamentals incl. top 5 = **armbar, triangle choke, rear-naked choke, guillotine, kimura**; Wk2 gi grips; Wk3 kimura; Wk4 theory & visualization; (3) home drills: shrimping, knee cutters, bridge and roll, guard retention + warm-ups **dynamic stretching, jumping jacks, lunges**. - Recommended **Toastmasters, Meetup, Eventbrite**, the library or community centre, and Facebook/LinkedIn groups.

- **Soundtracks**: Thomas Newman, Howard Shore, John Williams, Danny Elfman, Clint Mansell; *The Social Network*, *Inception*, *The Dark Knight*, *Grand Budapest Hotel*, *Interstellar*.
- **Crinklewitch pitches**: (1) "unleash your inner witch… race to collect three Winner Tokens… silly Rule Cards"; (2) "fast-paced… 2-6 players [wrong]… whimsical illustrations"; (3) "have you cackling with delight… up to eight players… magical night in"; (4) "hilarious… cast a spell on you… perfect for 2-8 players who love a good laugh". The user's verdict on (3) was "Can you try again?"; no verdict yet on (4).
- **Expansion ideas given**: new card types, new Rule Cards, new themes, solo mode, co-op mode, team/elimination modes.

## 10 · Jargon (Crinklewitch)

| Rule Card | Card that changes the rules for a round |

question: Can you suggest some activities I can do during my commute to work?
gold: The user would prefer suggestions related to listening to new podcasts or audiobooks, especially the genre beyond true crime or self-improvement, such as history. They may not be interested in activities that require visual attention, such as reading or watching videos, as they are commuting. The user would not prefer general podcast topics such as true crime or self-improvement, as the user wants to explore other topics.
answer:
Since your commute is about 40 minutes each way, here are some ideas that fit your interests:

**Listening (fine whether you drive or ride)**
- **History podcasts.** You wanted to branch out from true crime and self-improvement, so try the Mon–Tue *Hardcore History*, Wed–Thu *Lore*, Fri *The Dollop* plan. Episodes of about 30–60 minutes fit one leg of the trip. *Hardcore History* episodes are longer and often come in multi-part series, so spread them across a few trips.
- **The *Guns, Germs, and Steel* audiobook.** It fits with the history podcasts. Its main argument is that Eurasia's east–west layout helped crops, animals and technology spread. (I described this wrong earlier.)
- **Your soundtrack playlist.** Use the commute to try new composers for your weekly additions, like Thomas Newman, Howard Shore or Clint Mansell, and keep the best ones for focus time.
- **Self-improvement podcasts.** Pick episodes on confidence or public speaking to help you get ready for social events and a speaking group.

**Active but hands-free**
- **Practise speaking out loud.** Rehearse a short self-introduction or a 1–2 minute talk, which is good preparation for Toastmasters.
- **Visualise BJJ moves.** Run through your top 5 submissions in your head: armbar, triangle choke, rear-naked choke, guillotine and kimura. You can also replay your grip and kimura drills. This fits the theory and visualisation week of your plan.
- **Brainstorm Crinklewitch.** Record voice memos with new Bonus Card or Rule Card ideas, or work on the elevator pitch.

**If you're on public transport (not driving)**
- Read or take notes on what you're listening to.
- Sketch Crinklewitch card designs or sort out the Bonus Card list. Two cards, "Magic Amulet" and "Crystal Ball", each have two different effects right now.
- Watch the next Marvel show on your list, like *Loki* or *The Falcon and the Winter Soldier*. Save *Hawkeye* for watching with your sister.
- Look up drone photography basics, or plan outfits in your Closet app.
- Do a short mindfulness or breathing exercise to start or end the day calmly.

Do you drive or take transit? Once I know, I can put together a weekly plan for your commute.
